functions.name: sediment_filter
functions.signature: sediment_filter(flow: float, quality_in: dict, dt: float, parameters: dict) -> tuple
functions.purpose: Removes suspended solids and turbidity using sediment filtration.

functions.name: carbon_filter
functions.signature: carbon_filter(flow: float, quality_in: dict, dt: float, parameters: dict) -> tuple
functions.purpose: Removes organics, chlorine, taste/odor using activated carbon.

functions.name: uv_disinfection
functions.signature: uv_disinfection(flow: float, quality_in: dict, dt: float, parameters: dict) -> tuple
functions.purpose: Inactivates microbes with UV-C radiation and log reduction.

functions.name: ultrafiltration
functions.signature: ultrafiltration(flow: float, quality_in: dict, dt: float, parameters: dict) -> tuple
functions.purpose: Removes particles, colloids, bacteria via membrane filtration.

functions.name: nanofiltration
functions.signature: nanofiltration(flow: float, quality_in: dict, dt: float, parameters: dict) -> tuple
functions.purpose: Removes hardness, organics, multivalent ions with recovery optimization.

functions.name: remineralization
functions.signature: remineralization(flow: float, quality_in: dict, dt: float, parameters: dict) -> tuple
functions.purpose: Adds back minerals after NF/RO to reach target water quality.

dependencies: from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

functions.name: pathway_a
functions.signature: pathway_a(flow: float, quality_in: dict, dt: float, parameters: dict) -> tuple
functions.purpose: Pathway A: Sediment + Carbon + UV for basic treatment of good source water.

functions.name: pathway_b
functions.signature: pathway_b(flow: float, quality_in: dict, dt: float, parameters: dict) -> tuple
functions.purpose: Pathway B: Sediment + Carbon + UF + UV for higher turbidity/microbial risk water.

functions.name: pathway_c
functions.signature: pathway_c(flow: float, quality_in: dict, dt: float, parameters: dict) -> tuple
functions.purpose: Pathway C: NF + Remineralization + UV for high dissolved solids/hardness water.

functions.name: run_treatment_train
functions.signature: run_treatment_train(pathway: str, flow: float, quality_in: dict, dt: float, parameters: dict) -> tuple
functions.purpose: Selects and executes specified treatment pathway by name.

functions.name: treatment_train_series
functions.signature: treatment_train_series(pathway: str, flow_series: list, quality_series: list, dt: float, parameters: dict) -> tuple
functions.purpose: Runs treatment pathway over time-varying flow and quality inputs.

dependencies: from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
from .stages import sediment_filter, carbon_filter, uv_disinfection, ultrafiltration, nanofiltration, remineralization

water_treatment.summary: Water treatment module implements six stage processes that transform water quality. The train module orchestrates these into three pathways (A, B, C) representing increasing treatment complexity.

functions.name: levelized_cost
functions.signature: levelized_cost(capex: float, opex_annual: float, lifetime: float, discount_rate: float, output_annual: float, currency: str) -> dict
functions.purpose: Calculates Levelized Cost of Energy/Water using Capital Recovery Factor.

functions.name: simple_payback
functions.signature: simple_payback(capex: float, annual_savings: float, currency: str) -> dict
functions.purpose: Calculates undiscounted payback period as capex divided by annual savings.

functions.name: discounted_payback
functions.signature: discounted_payback(capex: float, annual_cashflows: list, discount_rate: float, currency: str) -> dict
functions.purpose: Calculates discounted payback by summing present values until cumulative exceeds capex.

functions.name: npv
functions.signature: npv(capex: float, annual_cashflows: list, discount_rate: float, currency: str) -> dict
functions.purpose: Calculates Net Present Value of cash flows minus initial investment.

functions.name: lifecycle_cost
functions.signature: lifecycle_cost(capex: float, opex_annual: float, replacement_costs: dict, lifetime: float, discount_rate: float, currency: str) -> dict
functions.purpose: Calculates total discounted lifecycle cost including replacements.

functions.name: bottlen_water_comparison
functions.signature: bottlen_water_comparison(system_cost_per_liter: float, bottled_price_per_liter: float, annual_volume: float, liters_per_bottle: float, currency: str) -> dict
functions.purpose: Compares system water cost vs bottled water with savings and payback metrics.

dependencies: from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
key_equations: Capital Recovery Factor: crf = discount_rate / (1 - (1 + discount_rate)**(-lifetime))
NPV: sum(cf / (1 + discount_rate)**(i+1) for i, cf in enumerate(annual_cashflows)) - capex

economics.summary: Economics module provides financial analysis tools including LCOE calculation, payback analysis, NPV evaluation, lifecycle cost accounting, and bottled water comparison using standard financial mathematics.
